summary: The same door is usable after applying the common disengaged-latch model. Only latch/lock bolt components 2 and 4 have no collision; visual geometry, leaf, frame, strike plate and handles are retained.
source_interference_resolution: Earlier latch/strike crossings are real in the original engaged geometry but irrelevant to the authorized closed-unlatched task. validation_scope: 14 focused preparation tests, static coverage of every required component, front/rear RTX review and one real-door GPU functional run. limitations: Only isolated-door technical readiness is established; robot reachability and the 45-degree expert criterion remain in 5.1.
Latch visuals remain in their original position while their collision is excluded; this is an explicit task abstraction, not a working lock model.
next_steps: Run the unchanged common robot/expert protocol in Subphase 5.1; do not declare expert qualification or corpus completion.
